crux: bike scale: given bike depth 16.49 m (C1-C3, 1.556x giant rider) vs common ground with the 1.8 m walker (C4/C5, round 1); secondary: handlebar setback behind the front contact (C4/C5 omit it)
fault_found: C1-C3's given-depth scale makes the seated rider 2.71 m (1.741 m common-ground height x 1.556), failing the adult-size hard check; C4/C5 put the handlebar directly above the front contact, so the grips, which sit 0.2-0.3 m behind it, read 5-10 pct too high
lesson: When correcting a part's height for its horizontal offset from the contact point, take the image-row change per metre of ground from the object's own contact track and speed rather than from a fitted ground plane; whether the ground slopes changes the correction by several percent, so bracket both.
